title: PhysxVehicleWheelControllerAPI
summary: Direct per-wheel drive torque, brake torque and steer angle for a vehicle without a drive, applied on a wheel attachment (a prim with PhysxVehicleWheelAttachmentAPI below the vehicle prim). The runtime checks each wheel attachment for it and reads its columns once, when the vehicle is created.

columns.name: physxVehicleWheelController:driveTorque
columns.absent: 0: no drive torque. Any value is accepted.

columns.name: physxVehicleWheelController:brakeTorque
columns.absent: 0: no brake torque. A present value outside [0, FLT_MAX) logs an error and the vehicle is not created.

columns.name: physxVehicleWheelController:steerAngle
columns.absent: 0: the wheel is not steered. Any value is accepted.
columns.notes: Radians, as the schema documents; passed to the vehicle without conversion.

interactions.rule: Read only for the wheel attachments of a vehicle that has no drive. On a vehicle with a drive (physxVehicle:drive or a drive API on the vehicle prim) the API is an illegal configuration: an error is logged and the vehicle is not created.
Mutually exclusive with PhysxVehicleControllerAPI on the vehicle prim; having both logs an error and the vehicle is not created.

notes: The prim must also carry PhysxVehicleWheelAttachmentAPI, which this contract does not describe yet; only wheel attachments the vehicle parse accepted are checked for this API.
All three columns are change-tracked: the runtime applies a new value while simulating; a negative brakeTorque then logs an error and is ignored.
